'Appendix: same rules at 30bp round trip' is a separate costed simulation and ends below the 0bp headline
Cash share reported at every rebalance
Cost sweep's 0bp row is the headline itself
Every bought or kept name was an index member at its signal date
Every buy ranked inside the top 20% band
Every fill is exactly 1 session after its signal
Every holding was an index member at its signal date (from the membership source)
Headline charged at the card's 0bp
NAV rebuilt from trades x Ace prices matches every daily return (within 0.5bp)
New positions sized at NAV x 0.001 / ATR share of price (whole shares)
No buy after a one-day move over 15% in 90 days (from Ace prices)
No buy below its 100-day average (from Ace prices)
No buy below its trend average
No buy while the index was below its 200-day average
No buy with a one-day move above 15% in the look-back
No trade outside the window
Signals on the Tuesday close (previous session if a holiday)
Traded value = shares x price (no cost inside the fills)
Trades fill at the price the card names (signal.params.fill_price)
Weights never renormalised to 100% (cash is a drift)
